properties.displayName: Process Create ASIM parser for Halcyon
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 1007                                    // OCSF Process Activity
    | extend
        EventType        = case(activity_id == 1, "ProcessCreated", activity_id == 2, "ProcessTerminated", "ProcessCreated"),
        TargetProcessId           = tostring(process.pid),
        TargetProcessName         = tostring(process.file.path),          // full image path
        TargetProcessCommandLine  = tostring(process.cmd_line),           // not populated for pre-execution blocks; populated when a command line was captured
        TargetProcessSHA256       = tostring(process.file.hashes[0].value),  // hashes[0] is always SHA-256
        ActingProcessId           = tostring(actor.process.pid),
        ActingProcessName         = tostring(actor.process.file.path),
        ActingProcessCommandLine  = tostring(actor.process.cmd_line),
        ActingProcessSHA256       = tostring(actor.process.file.hashes[0].value),
        ParentProcessId           = tostring(actor.process.parent_process.pid),
        ActorUsername             = tostring(actor.['user'].name),
        ActorUserId               = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        TargetUsername            = tostring(actor.['user'].name),         // launched process runs in the actor user context
        TargetUserId              = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        DvcId                     = tostring(device.uid),
        DvcHostname_raw           = tostring(device.hostname),
        EventOriginalSeverity     = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        Hash       = TargetProcessSHA256,
        HashType   = iff(isnotempty(TargetProcessSHA256), "SHA256", ""),
        // Security verdict drives EventResult/DvcAction, NOT status_id. Block (action_id 2) => Failure/Block
        // (launch prevented), Report (action_id 1) => Success/Allow, per Halcyon's security verdict mapping.
        EventResult = case(action_id == 2, "Failure", action_id == 1, "Success", "NA"),
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Block", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        TargetUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        TargetUserType     = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        TargetUserIdType   = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other"),
        ActorUsernameType  = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        ActorUserType      = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        ActorUserIdType    = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other"),
        DvcIdType   = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Dvc          = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        User         = TargetUsername,
        Process      = TargetProcessName,
        CommandLine  = TargetProcessCommandLine,
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "ProcessEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.4",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind)
                          )
    // Project only ASIM ProcessEvent/Common output columns (avoids project-away so new source columns don't leak into output).
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type,
        EventType,
        TargetProcessId,
        TargetProcessName,
        TargetProcessCommandLine,
        TargetProcessSHA256,
        ActingProcessId,
        ActingProcessName,
        ActingProcessCommandLine,
        ActingProcessSHA256,
        ParentProcessId,
        ActorUsername,
        ActorUserId,
        TargetUsername,
        TargetUserId,
        DvcId,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcFQDN,
        DvcDomain,
        DvcDomainType,
        Hash,
        HashType,
        EventResult,
        DvcAction,
        EventSeverity,
        TargetUsernameType,
        TargetUserType,
        TargetUserIdType,
        ActorUsernameType,
        ActorUserType,
        ActorUserIdType,
        DvcIdType,
        EventStartTime,
        Dvc,
        EventEndTime,
        User,
        Process,
        CommandLine,
        EventCount,
        EventUid,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventMessage,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventProduct,
        EventVendor,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled=disabled)
